meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. On what basis was the zero entered, Hale?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
Show me the page. A student misquoting Shakespeare is a mistake, Hale, not proof of anything. What else do you have?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.

You'll want to be very careful about your next sentence, Hale. Claire won her appeal, and I'm writing down that you said it "seems to run in the family." The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done here.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, and I will be raising your remark about my family with the principal. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: back at her opening position, agreeing to nothing and still wanting the zero withdrawn and the matter taken to the principal.
What moved her most: owning the missed phone call in one sentence earned a flat acknowledgement, because she respects a clean admission about procedure.
What cost the most ground: bringing up her daughter's old case and suggesting a family pattern, because it attacked her family instead of showing evidence about Owen's essay.
Try next time: when she asked to see the page with the misquoted line, put the essay in front of her and let her check it against the play, then stop talking.
